proof_model.claim_boundary: Abstract Dafny lemmas prove properties of their mathematical models only. They do not verify pinned C# code or establish the C#-to-model refinement.

field_mapping.abstract_field: map<SemanticKey, Observation> or selected structural key functions
field_mapping.unverified_premise: Byte-array equality, SHA-256 collision behavior, cache pruning/lifecycle, and actual mapping to SemanticKey are not proved.

field_mapping.upstream_field: GetHash dependency successors, builtins hash, CloneId
field_mapping.unverified_premise: Exact C# traversal, ordering, serialization, and resulting key equality are not refined to Dafny values.

mappings.evidence_kind: abstract mathematical lemma plus source inspection
unverified_premises: C# key calculation corresponds to the abstract key functions.
A key hit implies equivalent resolver observations.

field_mapping.unverified_premise: No object identity, AST graph, or ownership refinement is proved.
Reporter mutability, message provenance, replay and exact diagnostic correspondence are unproved.
Dictionary keys, scopes, signatures, type bindings, and symbol identity are not represented field-for-field.
Nested mutable dictionary/member graph and owner identity are not represented.

mappings.evidence_kind: abstract mathematical lemma plus pinned declaration inspection
unverified_premises: C# result fields refine abstract value observations.
Cached references remain safe under mutation and reattachment.

upstream.symbol: ModuleDecl; CloneId; token/span and clone members

field_mapping.upstream_field: ModuleDecl source/token origin, dependency and module identity
field_mapping.unverified_premise: Not every source field, synthetic module kind, or graph edge has a declared mapping.
Failed lookups, exports/opened-import visibility, all options, plugins, cancellation and ambient state are not exhaustively inventoried or mapped.

unverified_premises: The modeled context contains every C# resolution input.
The dependency graph captures all positive and negative name lookup effects.

field_mapping.unverified_premise: String/code snapshots do not model reporter behavior or diagnostic origins.
Name-only symbol audit is not complete semantic equivalence; symbol/type identity and rewriter effects are unproved.

mappings.evidence_kind: abstract mathematical lemma; limited C# behavior tests exist in repository CI history
mappings.tested_behavior_scope: Existing pinned integration evidence exercises selected stable diagnostics, symbol queries, verifier outcomes, safe fresh resolution, export-summary branch and nonempty-module exclusion. It does not exhaustively validate every mapped field or prove refinement.
unverified_premises: Rewriter side effects are deterministic and represented.
Abstract observations preserve all externally relevant C# behavior.

field_mapping.unverified_premise: C# safe branch must always call base resolver and never consume cached mutable result.

field_mapping.upstream_field: ModuleExportDecl empty signatures/members/messages; current declaration wrapper
field_mapping.unverified_premise: Pinned branch contract must remain unchanged; arbitrary rewriters and upstream revisions are outside the model.

mappings.evidence_kind: abstract mathematical lemma plus tested pinned C# behavior
mappings.tested_behavior_scope: Repository records pinned integration checks for safe path and restricted export summary. Passing abstract proofs alone provide no C# verification.
unverified_premises: Source branch corresponds to the formal branch for all executions.
No side effects outside modeled result fields affect observations.

evidence_categories.abstract_mathematical_lemma: Dafny verifies only the stated abstract functions, predicates, and methods.
evidence_categories.tested_csharp_behavior: Finite pinned-source integration tests provide sampled behavioral evidence, not proof.
evidence_categories.unverified_refinement: Every source-to-model correspondence premise not directly established by an independent refinement proof.
